issues.name: SQL Injection (Error-Based)
issues.issueBackground: SQL injection arises when user-supplied input is embedded in a SQL query without proper sanitization.
issues.remediationBackground: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database access.
issues.issueDetail: The parameter 'category' was tested with a single quote payload. The server returned a database syntax error disclosing internal PostgreSQL query structure.

requestresponse.request:
GET /v1/products?category=1' HTTP/1.1
Host: api.targetapp.com
User-Agent: Burp/2024.3

issues.name: Path Traversal (Scanner False Positive)
issues.issueBackground: Path traversal allows an attacker to access arbitrary files on the server.
issues.remediationBackground: Validate and whitelist filenames against an approved list.
issues.issueDetail: The file parameter was tested with dot-dot-slash sequence. The scanner observed a custom error message.

requestresponse.response:
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Server: Cloudflare
Content-Type: text/html

<html><title>403 Forbidden - Access Denied</title><body>WAF rule triggered: Path traversal attack detected</body></html>

issues.name: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected)
issues.issueBackground: Reflected XSS occurs when an application receives data in an HTTP request and includes that data within the immediate response without proper sanitization.
issues.remediationBackground: Context-aware HTML entity encoding should be applied to all reflected values.
issues.issueDetail: The parameter 'q' was reflected directly inside the response body without HTML encoding.

requestresponse.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
